messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Gray Screen when show out my app
parts:
Just a couple of thoughts that might be helpful:
- do you see any errors in the Browsers' JavaScript console ?
- have you changed the default application instance size from the default (medium) to something like large or xlarge to see if it makes a difference?

If you can include a link to your application we can see if we can debug the issue further ourselves.

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Gray Screen when show out my app
parts:
FYI, since R 3.2.0, there is a cross-platform method to read https
resources, which is to use a url() connection with the libcurl method,
e.g.

con = url('http://raw.githubusercontent.com/shirley-wang/STAT-480/613aec9f37e4042614edaada2bac1b5c855e8bcb/SpeedDating%20-%20Copy.csv',
method = 'libcurl')
x = read.csv(con)
str(x)

The OP was using R 3.1.3, so this method would not work.

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name
